title: Associate Director, AI Lead, Technology Consulting
description:
KPMG China provides multidisciplinary services from audit and tax to advisory, with a strong focus on serving our clients’ needs and their industries. Not only do we have an overriding commitment to provide the highest quality services for our clients, but we also strive to become a responsible corporate citizen that has a positive impact on our environment and
community. At KPMG, you’ll translate insights into action and reveal opportunities for all—our teams, our clients and our world.
Service Line Overview
The AI Lead will be responsible for designing, delivering, and scaling AI solutions for corporate clients across multiple industries. This role will lead a technical team (around 5–6 members) and work closely with business consultants to translate complex business issues and pain points into practical, high‑impact AI solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end design and implementation of AI/ML solutions for corporate clients, from problem definition and solution design to deployment and post implementation support.
Work closely with consulting teams and client stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify AI opportunities, and define solution roadmaps and success metrics.
Build, manage, and mentor a technical AI team, including junior engineers, data engineers/scientists, and system analysts.
Establish solution delivery standards, best practices, and reusable components for AI projects (e.g., frameworks, templates, code libraries).
Oversee technical architecture and integration of AI solutions with clients’ existing systems, data platforms, and security/governance requirements.
Drive experimentation and rapid prototyping of AI use cases (e.g., predictive analytics, NLP, computer vision, generative AI, automation) and convert successful prototypes into scalable solutions.
Ensure solution quality, performance, and reliability through rigorous testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders on go-to-market activities, proposals, and client presentations, including solution demos and proof-of-concept design.
Stay current on AI technologies, tools, and industry trends, and introduce new approaches that enhance the firm’s AI offerings.
Foster a culture of learning, adaptability, and innovation within the AI team.
Experience & Background
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Proven experience (6-8 years) in designing and implementing AI / machine learning / data-driven solutions in a corporate or enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience across the AI solution lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Solid understanding of AI/ML technologies and platforms (e.g., Python-based ML stacks, cloud AI services, MLOps tools, LLM / GenAI platforms).
Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring on/offshore technical teams, with the ability to grow talent from junior staff to senior technical roles.
Strong solution architecture skills, including experience integrating AI solutions into existing enterprise systems and workflows.
Experience working across multiple industries (e.g., financial services, retail, real estate, public sector) and adapting AI solutions to different business contexts.
Strong proficiency in both Chinese and English (written and spoken)
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear business language.
Proven track record in collaborating with consulting or business teams to translate business problems into technical requirements and solution design.
About KPMG
At KPMG China, we are committed to being an equal opportunity employer, with zero tolerance for any form of discrimination against any persons. It is important for us to create an inclusive, diverse and agile workplace for our people to develop and thrive at both a personal and professional level.
We strive to make ESG (environmental, social and governance) a watermark running through our organisation; from empowering our people to become agents of positive change, to providing better solutions and services to our clients to help them achieve their ESG goals. View Our Impact Plan to learn more about our ESG commitments and progress across four key pillars - Governance, People, Planet and Prosperity – and how we make a positive impact on our people, environment and society. We encourage you to come as you are, and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply, and hope you unlock opportunities with us. Visit KPMG China website for more company information.
You acknowledge and agree that all personal information hereby provided regarding yourself will be used by KPMG China for its candidate selection purposed only. KPMG China collects, uses, processes, and retains your personal information in accordance with KPMG China’s Online Privacy Statement and/or KPMG China Privacy Statement (collectively "
Privacy Statement
"). During the recruitment process, KPMG China may need to store personal information of candidates in a designated third-party application tracking platform.
If you have any questions regarding the information you provided in the form or your job application in general, please contact KPMG China’s HR personnel in the location where your application is submitted [see here].

How you’ll apply

title: Software Engineer - ML / AI Engineer (Perm/Contract)
description:
221b Limited (“221b”) is an Integrated Anti-Crime platform using AI and network analytics to assist in the investigation of multi-domain crime, e.g. financial fraud, AML, and communication surveillance. Making financial fraud detection fast & easy.
We are looking for a forward-thinking ML / AI Engineer to join our team and contribute to a confidential large language model (LLM) project in the financial services domain. You will work on advanced AI implementation, covering the full model development lifecycle from data preparation and fine-tuning through to production deployment. This role is hands-on and delivery-focused. You will collaborate closely with the cross-functional development team and directly shape the AI capabilities of a live, mission-critical system.
Responsibilities:
Fine-tune open-weight language models on domain-specific data using techniques such as SFT, Quantization, LoRA/QLoRA.
Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including policy document ingestion and vector database integration.
Serve and optimize model inference using production engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) to meet strict latency and throughput SLAs.
Manage MLOps and deployment pipelines across DEV, UAT, PRE-PRD, and PRD environments on enterprise cloud infrastructure (IBM watsonx.ai / OpenShift).
Utilize modern LLMs and agentic coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GPT-based tools) to accelerate development, code generation, and prompt engineering.
Evaluate emerging open-source models, inference frameworks, and AI libraries for production feasibility.
Produce technical validation reports and contribute to system design and test documentation.
Collaborate with backend and frontend engineers to integrate AI capabilities into the core platform.
Requirements:
Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or model serving in production environments.
Strong proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals.
Familiarity with Hugging Face Transformers (e.g. Qwen, Deepseek), LangChain, LlamaIndex, vLLM, or similar tools.
Experience with prompt engineering and utilizing cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate development cycles.
Ability to read and write technical documentation in English.
Nice-to-Haves:
Experience with advanced fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, Unsloth, DPO, or RLHF.
Familiarity with quantization (INT4, INT8) and production inference optimization.
Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, pgvector).
Exposure to IBM watsonx.ai, OpenShift, or Kubernetes.
Experience with multilingual NLP, particularly CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) datasets.
Prior hands-on experience with AI projects in financial services or regulated industry.
What We Offer:
Flexible working hours and work-from-home policy.
Subsidized access to premium AI development tools to empower your workflow.
On-job training and technical guidance from senior engineers.
Opportunity to work on a high-impact, production LLM system in the financial services sector.
Exposure to cutting-edge open-weight model stack and enterprise-grade deployment practices.
Job Highlights:
Flexible working hours and work-from-home policy
Hands-on work on confidential LLM projects in Fintech
Great opportunity to deepen expertise in LLM fine-tuning, RAG, and MLOps
